EVERFI · ComplyEQ

Reusable patterns for workplace learning.

This workplace-learning configuration library brings recurring scenarios, assessments, resources and policy acknowledgement into shared desktop and mobile patterns.

ProjectWorkplace Culture Network
Contribution / source recordProject-specific role to confirm.

Design approach

  • Feedback appears close to scenario choices, with explicit retry and progression states.
  • Configurable policy patterns combine a resource link, acknowledgement and controlled progression.
  • The library documents recurring structures such as accordions, steppers, modals and progressive disclosure for handoff.

Why this work matters

The strongest story is system-level consistency: a reusable interaction vocabulary for varied workplace-training content.

Reference notes

Reviewed original configuration and handoff material. Confirm project-level ownership and adoption. The files do not establish a single country-specific course or measured delivery savings.
